kicker: Cervical Cancer · BMC Women's Health 2026;26:108 · Prospective
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · BMC Women's Health 2026;26:108 · 前瞻性
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation in Cervical Exfoliated Cells: High-Grade Lesions & Vaginal Dysbiosis
title_zh: 宫颈脱落细胞 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化：高级别病变与阴道微生态失调
subtitle: 264 colposcopy-referred women — CIN2+ AUC 0.826; methylation links to Lactobacillus loss and Gardnerella overgrowth
subtitle_zh: 264 例转诊阴道镜女性——CIN2+ AUC 0.826；甲基化与乳杆菌减少、加德纳菌富集相关
authors: Luo L, Wang L, Liu Z, Cai Y, Zhang J
authors_zh: 罗恋梅, 王兰若, 刘志英, 蔡有琴, 张军

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: vaginal dysbiosis is linked to HPV persistence and lesions, but its relationship with host DNA methylation was unknown.
Question: is PAX1/JAM3 methylation a robust CIN2+ biomarker, and how does it relate to the vaginal microbiome?
Why it matters: connecting methylation to the microbiome could reveal host–microbe interactions in cervical carcinogenesis.
bullets_zh: 空白：阴道微生态失调与 HPV 持续感染和病变相关，但其与宿主 DNA 甲基化的关系未明。
问题：PAX1/JAM3 甲基化是否为稳健的 CIN2+ 标志物？它与阴道微生态有何关联？
意义：将甲基化与微生态相连，可揭示宫颈癌变中的宿主–微生物互作。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective cross-sectional (Feb–Dec 2024); Beijing Anzhen Hospital; 66.7% TZ-III.
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); hrHPV genotyping; Gram-stain vaginal ecology (172 women).
Pathology: 30 CIN2 / 35 CIN3 / 5 SCC / 1 adenocarcinoma among CIN2+.
Analysis: diagnostic performance + microbiome correlations.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性横断面（2024.2–12）；北京安贞医院；66.7% 为 Ⅲ 型转化区。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；hrHPV 分型；革兰染色阴道微生态（172 例）。
病理：CIN2+ 含 CIN2 30 / CIN3 35 / 鳞癌 5 / 腺癌 1。
分析：诊断效能 + 微生态相关性。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CIN2+: AUC 0.826 (sens 76.1% / spec 89.1%); CIN3+ AUC 0.852 (87.8% / 82.5%).
vs hrHPV: specificity 89.1% vs 7.3% — a 12× gap; all SCC and adenocarcinoma CISCER-positive.
Methylation gradient: ΔCtPAX1 4.25 (CIN2+) vs 9.35 (CIN1−); ΔCtJAM3 9.34 vs 13.2.
Microbiome: in CIN3+, Lactobacillus dropped (34% vs 84% normal) while Gardnerella rose (34% vs 3.2%); pH higher.
bullets_zh: vs hrHPV：特异度 89.1% vs 7.3%——12 倍差距；鳞癌与腺癌全部 CISCER 阳性。
甲基化梯度：ΔCtPAX1 4.25（CIN2+）vs 9.35（CIN1−）；ΔCtJAM3 9.34 vs 13.2。
微生态：CIN3+ 中乳杆菌骤降（34% vs 正常 84%），加德纳菌升高（34% vs 3.2%）；pH 升高。

panels.title: Correlations
bullets: Lesion grade vs: ΔCtPAX1 (r=−0.552), ΔCtJAM3 (r=−0.607), Lactobacillus (r=−0.316) — all negatively correlated.
Positively correlated: Nugent score (r=0.499) and Gardnerella (r=0.354) with lesion severity.
Implication: dysbiosis (loss of Lactobacillus, Gardnerella overgrowth) accompanies the methylation accumulation seen in high-grade lesions.
bullets_zh: 病变分级 vs：ΔCtPAX1（r=−0.552）、ΔCtJAM3（r=−0.607）、乳杆菌（r=−0.316）——均负相关。
正相关：Nugent 评分（r=0.499）与加德纳菌（r=0.354）随病变加重而升高。
启示：微生态失调（乳杆菌减少、加德纳菌富集）伴随高级别病变中的甲基化累积。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Robust molecular triage: CISCER AUC 0.826–0.852 for CIN2+/CIN3+ — with 89% specificity vs 7% for hrHPV.
Microbiome link: dysbiosis and methylation accumulate together — a window into host–microbe interplay in cervical cancer.
bullets_zh: 稳健的分子分流：CISCER 检测 CIN2+/CIN3+ AUC 0.826–0.852——特异度 89% vs hrHPV 的 7%。
微生态关联：微生态失调与甲基化同步累积——窥见宫颈癌宿主–微生物互作之窗。

kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Clin Epigenetics 2026;18:73 · 横断面
title: Combined PAX1/JAM3 Methylation for Early Diagnosis of Cervical Precancerous Lesions
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 联合甲基化检测宫颈癌前病变的效能与应用潜力
subtitle: 431 cervical samples — CIN2+ AUC 0.89, CIN3+ AUC 0.93; referral rate only 19.3%
subtitle_zh: 431 例宫颈样本——CIN2+ AUC 0.89，CIN3+ AUC 0.93；转诊率仅 19.3%
authors: Fan G, Yu X, Keremu Y, Kong W, Xu X, Ma X
authors_zh: 范国, 俞晓璐, 依丽米努尔·克热木, 孔维娜, 徐晓慧, 马秀敏

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: early detection of precancerous lesions needs a simple, objective triage beyond cytology — especially in under-screened regions.
Question: how effective is combined PAX1/JAM3 methylation for early diagnosis of CIN2+/CIN3+?
Why it matters: a scalable methylation test could improve early diagnosis and guide referral decisions.
bullets_zh: 空白：癌前病变的早诊需要超越细胞学的简单客观分流——尤其筛查不足地区。
问题：PAX1/JAM3 联合甲基化对 CIN2+/CIN3+ 早诊的效果如何？
意义：可推广的甲基化检测可改善早诊并指导转诊决策。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: retrospective cross-sectional (Sep 2024–Feb 2025); Xinjiang Medical University Affiliated Cancer Hospital.
Population: 81 controls / 161 CIN1 / 77 CIN2 / 96 CIN3 / 16 cancer; 100-case sub-cohort for PAX1/SOX1.
Methylation: qMSP (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 / ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); binary logistic for combined indicator.
Outcome: CIN2+/CIN3+ diagnostic performance.
bullets_zh: 设计：回顾性横断面（2024.9–2025.2）；新疆医科大学附属肿瘤医院。
人群：对照 81 / CIN1 161 / CIN2 77 / CIN3 96 / 癌 16；100 例亚队列测 PAX1/SOX1。
甲基化：qMSP（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 / ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；二元 Logistic 构建联合指标。
结局：CIN2+/CIN3+ 诊断效能。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Combined PAX1/JAM3: CIN2+ AUC 0.89 (83.1% / 88.8%); CIN3+ AUC 0.93 (85.7% / 87.8%).
Methylation gradient: positivity 8.6% (control) → 77.9% (CIN2) → 95.8% (CIN3) → 100% (cancer).
Non-16/18 hrHPV: methylation CIN2+ 69.2%/86.4% vs cytology 93.8%/27.9% — far more specific.
Referral rate: only 19.3% (51/265) with methylation-based triage.
bullets_zh: 甲基化梯度：阳性率 8.6%（对照）→ 77.9%（CIN2）→ 95.8%（CIN3）→ 100%（癌）。
非16/18 hrHPV：甲基化 CIN2+ 69.2%/86.4% vs 细胞学 93.8%/27.9%——特异度远高。
转诊率：基于甲基化的分流仅 19.3%（51/265）。

panels.title: Complementary marker
bullets: PAX1/SOX1: sub-cohort CIN3+ AUC 0.91 (76.9% / 94.6%) — a promising complementary panel.
Dual-panel value: SOX1 adds a different pathway read-out, potentially covering cases PAX1/JAM3 misses.
Clinical fit: high specificity supports using methylation to select women for colposcopy in resource-limited settings.
bullets_zh: PAX1/SOX1：亚队列 CIN3+ AUC 0.91（76.9% / 94.6%）——有前景的互补组合。
双组合价值：SOX1 提供不同通路读数，或可覆盖 PAX1/JAM3 漏检的病例。
临床适配：高特异度支持在资源有限地区用甲基化筛选需行阴道镜的女性。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Strong early-diagnosis tool: combined PAX1/JAM3 reached AUC 0.93 for CIN3+ with a clear methylation–severity gradient.
Only 19.3% referral — objective, scalable triage for early cervical precancer detection.
bullets_zh: 强大的早诊工具：PAX1/JAM3 联合检测 CIN3+ AUC 0.93，甲基化–严重度梯度清晰。
转诊率仅 19.3%——宫颈癌前病变早诊的客观、可推广分流。
